0022600017.text: The Detroit Pistons, who are 4-1 and first in the Central and first in the East, visit the Brooklyn Nets in the sixth game of Detroit's season, and they come in on a one-game winning streak. Brooklyn is 0-4, has lost four straight, and sits 15th in the East and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic, with Egor Demin and Tyler Bilodeau both out for the Nets. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, but Detroit won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 138-100 win in Brooklyn on March 10, and the Pistons will be without Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain) while Isaiah Joe is day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision.
